summary: Comprehensive testing of 3-Layer Capture Architecture for Chrome Extension profile capture endpoint. All 13 tests passed. The 3-Layer architecture is correctly gated for admin@vhc.in only and properly preserves DOM fields while extracting phone/email from regex (L2) and triggering Claude only when phone is missing (L3).

minor.issue: STALE PHONE blocking can prevent phone extraction if test phone numbers already exist in DB - this is expected behavior for dedup but affects testing

critical_code_review_comments: 3-Layer architecture implementation is correct and well-structured
DOM fields (company, designation, CTC, notice, location, skills) are properly preserved for admin@vhc.in with dom_scraped=true
Phone/Email extraction from regex (L2) works correctly when DOM values are empty/masked
Claude CV scan (L3) is correctly triggered ONLY when phone is still missing after L1+L2
Non-admin users correctly use standard pipeline even with dom_scraped=true
Admin users without dom_scraped=true correctly use standard pipeline
Dedup and mandate linking regression tests pass for 3-Layer captures
seed_data_creation: None - tests use unique identifiers and clean up after themselves
context_for_next_testing_agent: 3-Layer Capture Architecture tests are comprehensive. Key test scenarios covered: (1) DOM fields preserved for admin, (2) L2 phone/email extraction, (3) L3 Claude triggering only when phone missing, (4) Non-admin uses standard pipeline, (5) Admin without dom_scraped uses standard pipeline, (6) Dedup and mandate linking regression. Use unique phone numbers (6xxxxxxxxx, 7xxxxxxxxx) to avoid STALE PHONE blocking. Use Naukri format with ₹ symbol for page_text CTC parsing.

tests_executed.description: 3-Layer capture with dom_scraped=true for admin@vhc.in: DOM fields preserved and NOT overwritten
3-Layer L2: Phone extraction from regex when DOM phone is empty/masked
3-Layer L2: Email extraction from regex when DOM email is missing
3-Layer: When phone IS found by regex (L2), Claude is NOT triggered and enrichment_source is 'dom_3layer'
Non-admin (yamini@vhc.in) with dom_scraped=true: 3-Layer logic NOT activated, page_text OVERRIDES CTC
Admin with dom_scraped=false: uses standard pipeline, not 3-Layer
Non-admin standard capture (dom_scraped=false): existing hybrid pipeline unchanged
Regression: dedup by naukri_profile_id still works for 3-Layer captures
Regression: mandate linking still works for 3-Layer captures
3-Layer capture with phone found has enrichment_source='dom_3layer'
3-Layer L3: Background Claude triggered when phone is still missing after L1+L2
3-Layer capture: DOM skills are preserved and not overwritten
